title: Hand Self-Massage
summary: The thumb of the free hand gently works the palm, then the fingers are lightly stroked.
goal: Relax the hands after repetitive activity.
startingPosition: Rest the hand comfortably in front of you.
instructions: Make small circles over the fleshy area.
Lightly stroke the back of the hand.
Stroke each finger from base to tip.
direction: Over the palm, back of the hand, and fingers.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
